Let    * \(A_A\) = Andrea’s apples   * \(B_A\) = Andrea’s bananas   * \(A_J\) = Jamal’s apples   * \(B_J\) = Jamal’s bananas    The statements give the following equations    1. Emily peels shrimp at a rate of    \[ 6\text{ shrimp/minute} \]  so to peel 90 shrimp she needs    \[ \frac{90\text{ shrimp}}{6\text{ shrimp/min}} = 15\text{ minutes}. \]  She sautés shrimp at a rate of    \[ 30\text{ shrimp in }10\text{ minutes} = 3\text{ shrimp/minute}. \]  To cook 90 shrimp she needs    \[ \frac{90\text{ shrimp}}{3\text{ shrimp/min}} = 30\text{ minutes}. \]  Since the peeling and cooking steps are done sequentially, the total time is    \[ 15\text{ min (peeling)} + 30\text{ min (cooking)} = 45\text{ minutes}. \]  **Answer: 45 minutes.**
